notes: Encoded ONLY from this page; no data imported from any other Dayton source. Style 2 counting follows the Wave 3 Nordyne lesson: the page states year = 2nd & 3rd numerical digits and week = 4th & 5th numerical digits. Under digit-only counting the page's own example L874737886 gives week 73 (invalid, above 53), so that reading is falsified by the page's own example; under character counting the same example gives year 87 (1987) and week 47 (valid), so character counting is this page's convention and is shipped. Patterns are disjoint (4-digit date code vs letter + 9 digits), so no shape collision.

styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = month, 3-4 = year (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges [0,2] and [2,4].

Page positions stated as 2nd & 3rd numerical digits = year, 4th & 5th numerical digits = week; applied as character positions [1,3] and [3,5] on the normalized serial (see file notes for why digit-only counting is falsified by this example).
